notes.title: 🌟 Forest Dump: Prologue - Update 0.0.2! 🌟
notes.content:
Dear forest friends,

We're excited to announce Update 0.0.2 for Forest Dump: Prologue! Your feedback has been crucial in shaping these improvements:

- 🃏 Starting Hand: Our foxy hero now begins each run with cards in hand!
- 🎵 New Dialogue Sounds: We've replaced the fictional language with keyboard typing sounds.
- ⚡ Performance Optimization: Fine-tuned settings for better resource management.
- 🖼️ Texture Upscaling: Enjoy enhanced visuals in your forest adventure!
- 🔗 Discord Button Fix: Now correctly directs you to our community.

Thank you for being so supportive as we continue to refine Forest Dump. Happy gaming!
